events.text:
A FRIENDLY WORD
Pell the lamplighter

Pell lowers his pole and leans down to your skiff. "Heard something on my rounds. Tomorrow: The Dreamsilk dealers of Saint Mire are on strike. Supply has dried up."

Pell thinks it likely. Rumours like this land in full about half the time. About 1 in 5 turns the other way.
If it holds, tomorrow at Saint Mire: sell Dreamsilk there. It is two nights away, so you would arrive as it fades. Either way, you will hear what really happened.
